Group Inspection

One Project, One Trip, Lower Rate Each

When several owners in the same project book together, we inspect unit after unit on consecutive days. Less travel for us, a lower rate for you — and every owner still gets their own full report.

WhatsApp Us About Your Project See the Rates
Your DLP clock is already runningThe Defect Liability Period starts the day you take vacant possession — not the day you move in. Once it expires, every repair becomes your own cost. Book while the developer is still liable.
Group Rates

The More Units, The Lower Each Pays

Same inspection, same report — the saving comes from doing one trip instead of many.

Group rates depend on your project, property type and how many units join. Message us with those three things and we will confirm the rate in writing — no obligation.

Get Our Group Rate
How It Works

Four Steps, Start to Report

1

Collect names in your group

One coordinator gathers the unit numbers of everyone who wants in. A WhatsApp list is enough.

2

Send us the list

Message us the project name, handover date and how many units. We confirm the rate in writing.

3

We schedule by block

We inspect unit after unit over consecutive days, so nobody waits weeks for a slot.

4

Each owner gets their own report

Separate report per unit, with photos, readings and repair priority — yours alone, not a shared summary.

For Coordinators

Organising For Your Group?

If you are the one holding the group together, this is what you should know before you put our name forward.

  • Everyone in the group sees the same defects raised properly, not a mix of guesses
  • You are not paying more for organising — the coordinator pays the same group rate
  • We handle the scheduling, you only pass on the dates
  • We can join your group chat to answer questions directly, if you want

Talk to us first

Tell us your project and roughly how many are interested. We will send you the rate and a short message you can paste straight into your group.
